_comment: Any edit here is lost on the next generate. Change the award in ckf.hardmode.json#teampl and regenerate; that keeps the number the victory screen prints equal to the number the save actually banks.

These rules exist because the award and the label are read through two different layers: the award is a SQL aggregate that materialises no row, the label is the row materialiser. A rules.json edit is invisible to the first and a teampl.json edit is invisible to the second.
30 rule(s). Cells equal to the game's own value are omitted — setting a column to what it already holds changes nothing.
